title: Healthymouse
requirements: Correction and optimization of a high-tech space helmet asset to apply an interactive cartoon-style rendering outline. The client required a perfectly calibrated black inverse hull surrounding the outer glass, precise color subdivision between the frame and the visor, and complete technical support resolving texture-linkage anomalies within game-engine nodes.
achievements: Implemented a lightweight inverse-hull vertex outline technique that loads smoothly on mobile devices
Corrected viewport orientation issues and eliminated blue-tint rendering bugs
Provided step-by-step diagnostic media explaining real-time material integration
